{"metadata":{"description":"Unofficial Windows and macOS desktop app for DeepSeek Harness, with bundled runtime and automatic reuse of existing DSH environments.","id":"gh:1334946785","install_available":false,"language":"JavaScript","name":"dsh-desktop","slug":"yxccai/dsh-desktop","topics":["deepdeepseek","deepseek-harness","desktop","desktop-app","dsh","dsh-desktop","dsh-plugin","dsh-plugin-desktop","dsh-plugins","sider"]},"paragraphs":[{"id":"p1s1","text":"Unofficial Windows and macOS desktop app for DeepSeek Harness, with bundled runtime and automatic re"},{"id":"p1s2","text":"use of existing DSH environments."},{"id":"p2s1","text":"# DSH Desktop"},{"id":"p3s1","text":"English | 简体中文"},{"id":"p4s1","text":"An unofficial open-source desktop app for DeepSeek Harness, designed to provide a simpler and more c"},{"id":"p4s2","text":"onvenient desktop experience."},{"id":"p5s1","text":"## Highlights"},{"id":"p6s1","text":"### A desktop shell around the official DSH Web — inherited features, secure, and easy to keep curre"},{"id":"p6s2","text":"# A desktop shell around the official DSH Web — inherited features, secure, and easy to keep current"},{"id":"p7s1","text":"DSH Desktop does not reimplement any functionality; it wraps the official DSH Web in a native deskto"},{"id":"p7s2","text":"op does not reimplement any functionality; it wraps the official DSH Web in a native desktop window:"},{"id":"p8s1","text":"- **One-click launch**: No browser tab, no URL, no command line — double-click the desktop icon to e"},{"id":"p8s2","text":"nter the same runtime environment as the official Web.
- **Feature inheritance**: The official DSH W"},{"id":"p8s3","text":"eb serves as the host runtime, loading its full UI and plugin system while sessions, workspace data,"},{"id":"p8s4","text":" and the plugin ecosystem are fully preserved; the Web plugin market component among the built-in pl"},{"id":"p8s5","text":"ugins manages plugins for both the desktop and the Web version from a single place.
- **Safe isolati"},{"id":"p8s6","text":"on**: The renderer never receives direct Node.js, filesystem, or arbitrary command access; the Elect"},{"id":"p8s7","text":"ron sandbox, contextIsolation, loopback-only navigation, and a whitelisted IPC layer form the isolat"},{"id":"p8s8","text":"ion boundary.
- **Simple upgrades**: When the official DSH ships a new version, the desktop updates "},{"id":"p8s9","text":"with a version bump and a rebuilt bundle. Existing `DSH_HOME`, sessions, Agent Presets, and persiste"},{"id":"p8s10","text":"nt plugins carry over unchanged."},{"id":"p9s1","text":"### Foundation stays lean — only a few practical desktop enhancements"},{"id":"p10s1","text":"The base build does not pile on features; it keeps the official Web experience and adds only the enh"},{"id":"p10s2","text":"ancements most useful in a desktop context:"},{"id":"p11s1","text":"- **Project panel**: Beside the chat, it lists the files actually modified or produced by each reply"},{"id":"p11s2","text":". Multi-tab previews cover Markdown, HTML, source code, diff, CSV, PDF, images, and text, with split"},{"id":"p11s3","text":" editing and conflict-aware atomic saves. Git workspaces show real status and per-file discard; non-"},{"id":"p11s4","text":"Git directories use content snapshots (no `git init`, nothing written into the project). Each reply "},{"id":"p11s5","text":"records a recoverable snapshot, and restoring always saves the current state as a recovery point fir"},{"id":"p11s6","text":"st.
- **Built-in plugins (optional install)**: Built-ins are offered as a selectable catalog rather "},{"id":"p11s7","text":"than pre-installed. Available now: multiple color themes (Deep Ocean Blue, Aurora Green-Purple, Rose"},{"id":"p11s8","text":" Sunset Pink, Warm Sand Amber, each with light and dark modes), a custom image background (native fi"},{"id":"p11s9","text":"le picker, adjustable opacity, instant disable), and a lightweight writing assistant (drafting, rewr"},{"id":"p11s10","text":"iting, summarizing, translating). All support install, disable, and uninstall on demand.
- **Windows"},{"id":"p11s11","text":" system notifications (optional)**: Get a native notification when the agent awaits approval, finish"},{"id":"p11s12","text":"es a task, or stops with an error — no need to watch the page constantly. Toggle it anytime under Se"},{"id":"p11s13","text":"ttings → Plugins → Built-in Plugins; off by default."},{"id":"p12s1","text":"### Extensible and creative — a complete plugin ecosystem on a lean base"},{"id":"p13s1","text":"The base stays light; extension capabilities are directly available:"},{"id":"p14s1","text":"- **Built-in plugins keep growing**: Official curated plugins ship through a trusted channel with in"},{"id":"p14s2","text":"tegrity verification, and can be installed, disabled, or uninstalled without touching user content.
"},{"id":"p14s3","text":"- **Community plugin market**: A fixed, verified copy of the community market component is included."},{"id":"p14s4","text":" Once enabled, Settings → Plugins → Plugin Market browses awesome-dsh-plugin.com — install, update, "},{"id":"p14s5","text":"and uninstall community plugins centrally, with a bundled `pnpm` so nothing needs to be installed gl"},{"id":"p14s6","text":"obally.
